name: J.M. Smucker

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (The J.M. Smucker Company logo.svg)

description: J.M. Smucker sells packaged coffee (Folgers, Dunkin' under licence, Cafe Bustelo), frozen sandwiches and spreads (Uncrustables, Jif, Smucker's), pet food and snacks (Meow Mix, Milk-Bone), Hostess sweet baked snacks, and foodservice products. Most revenue comes from selling brands to US grocery, club, mass and pet retailers; Walmart (including Sam's Club) was 34 percent of FY2026 net sales. Coffee is the largest and most profitable line, so green coffee prices drive results. The 2023 Hostess acquisition has been written down hard: goodwill and trademark impairments of $961.7M in FY2026 (after $1.98B in FY2025), and Sweet Baked Snacks now has no goodwill left.

businessLines.name: U.S. Retail Coffee
businessLines.how: Sells branded packaged coffee to grocery, club, mass and online retailers; price is reset as green-coffee costs move, and Dunkin' carries royalties to the licensor.
businessLines.description: Folgers, Dunkin' (under three licences for packaged coffee and K-Cup pods in retail) and Cafe Bustelo.

operatingProfit.note: Segment profit; share is of $2,006.4M total segment profit; vs $795.1M FY2025

businessLines.name: U.S. Retail Pet Foods
businessLines.how: Branded cat food and dog snacks sold to grocery, mass, pet-specialty and online retailers at premium prices; recurring purchases.
businessLines.description: Meow Mix, Milk-Bone, Pup-Peroni, Canine Carry Outs.

businessLines.name: U.S. Retail Frozen Handheld and Spreads
businessLines.how: Branded frozen sandwiches and peanut-butter and fruit spreads sold to grocery, club and mass retailers; Uncrustables is the growth product.

businessLines.name: Sweet Baked Snacks
businessLines.how: Branded snack cakes sold to grocery, mass, dollar and convenience channels; the segment has moderate seasonality (10-K).
businessLines.description: Hostess (Donettes, Twinkies, CupCakes, DingDongs, Zingers, CoffeeCakes, HoHos, Mini Muffins, Fruit Pies); acquired 2023-11-07; some value brands sold to JTM Foods 2025-03-03 and Voortman sold 2024-12-02.

operatingProfit.note: Segment profit before impairments; vs $219.8M FY2025

businessLines.name: Away From Home
businessLines.how: Sells coffee, portion-control products, toppings and Uncrustables to restaurants, schools and other foodservice customers, directly and through distributors.
businessLines.description: Folgers, Smucker's and Uncrustables sold into foodservice; became a separately reportable segment in Q4 FY2026.

businessLines.name: Other
businessLines.how: Not described further in the 10-K text read.
businessLines.description: Residual products and operations outside the five reportable segments.

brands.name: Folgers, Dunkin', Cafe Bustelo
brands.note: Retail coffee, 36.5 percent of FY2026 net sales; Dunkin' under licence with royalties

brands.name: Uncrustables, Jif, Smucker's
brands.note: Frozen handheld and spreads, 20.5 percent of net sales

brands.name: Meow Mix, Milk-Bone, Pup-Peroni, Canine Carry Outs
brands.note: Pet foods, 17.7 percent of net sales

brands.name: Hostess
brands.note: Sweet baked snacks, 10.7 percent of net sales; acquired 2023-11-07
